name: T-Mobile Essentials Saver
autoPayAssumptions: Pricing reflects $5/line monthly discount with eligible AutoPay (linked bank account or debit card). Without AutoPay, add $5 per line each month.
taxAndFeeAssumptions: Taxes and government/regulatory fees are not included and are billed additionally (typically $5-$10/line depending on jurisdiction).
dataAndHotspotFeatures: 50 GB of high-speed mobile data per month; speeds may be slowed during congestion
eligibilityCriteria: Available to new and existing T-Mobile single or dual-line customers
Strict account limit of maximum 2 voice lines

name: T-Mobile Essentials Choice 55+
autoPayAssumptions: Pricing reflects $5/line monthly discount with eligible AutoPay (linked bank account or debit card). Without AutoPay, add $5 per line each month.
taxAndFeeAssumptions: Taxes and government/regulatory fees are not included and are billed additionally.
dataAndHotspotFeatures: 50 GB of premium high-speed mobile data per month
eligibilityCriteria: Primary account holder must be 55 years of age or older
Age verification required via valid government ID within 45 days of activation
Maximum of 2 voice lines per senior discount account
